falseAssumptions.claim: 20 published points currently fit within 0.07 m.
falseAssumptions.correction: 9 current points on 2 cones (A 4, 3.2.3 5), in-sample; 3 points (9.2) are stale; the 8 Barclay values are not fitted.

falseAssumptions.claim: 9.2 is calibrated (k 0.0488) for the current cone.
falseAssumptions.correction: The sheet predates the Feb 2026 origin move; k belongs to the Walking Figures origin and is historical.

falseAssumptions.claim: A cone's lower boundary is a flat plane at one constant geodetic height.
falseAssumptions.correction: It is a rising sight line: Z = Lv + k*D.

falseAssumptions.claim: A roof-aligned lower boundary passes through the highest roof point.
falseAssumptions.correction: It grazes the roof return with the maximum elevation angle (z - Lv)/D, usually a near parapet; penthouses are excluded unless named.

falseAssumptions.claim: City sheet points all lie within 4 degrees of cone axes, so radial and axial distance cannot be separated.
falseAssumptions.correction: 9.2 points lie 6.0-6.3 degrees off the bisector (A 0.5-1.9, 3.2.3 3.1-3.7). Planar fits better: A 0.012 vs 0.037 m, 9.2 0.008 vs 0.024 m.

falseAssumptions.claim: Cone heights are published nowhere, so no height test is possible.
falseAssumptions.correction: No surface is published, but reference parameters appear in Council reports for several cones and the City issues per-site geodetic sheets.

falseAssumptions.claim: EFFECTIVE_DATE identifies the cone version.
falseAssumptions.correction: Only view 28 shows 2026-02-04; 9.1, 9.2, H, J2 and 3.2.4 changed in 2025-26 yet show 2024-07-10.

falseAssumptions.claim: Geometry hashes flag every amended view (H and 3.2.4 included).
falseAssumptions.correction: H and 3.2.4 changed lower boundaries only (Dec 2025), so their polygons are unchanged; also hash the PVG PDF and read Council decisions naming 'Public View'.

falseAssumptions.claim: No aviation rule applies downtown; it is case-by-case only.
falseAssumptions.correction: No zoning surface, but CAR 601.23 makes any structure above 150 m AGL an obstacle (above 90 m within 6 km of an aerodrome); 601.24 requires notice and Standard 621 marking.

falseAssumptions.claim: One curvature switch (drop D^2/2R), default off, is safe for the minimum surface.
falseAssumptions.correction: The sign depends on the anchor: a line fixed at a far reference sits below linear interpolation by d(Dr-d)(1-kappa)/2R (plane overstates, up to 2.1 m for view 20); a line fixed by an angle at the eye rises by (1-kappa)d^2/2R.

falseAssumptions.claim: Service polygons already hold 2026 Trout Lake boundaries and Council adopted them on 4 Feb 2026.
falseAssumptions.correction: Council referred the Trout Lake amendments back (RTS 19750 p.4); service 27.1/27.2 equal the pre-2026 corner bearings.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 9.2 'roof of 485 W 8th Ave' test shows that roof alignments cannot give Lr.
falseAssumptions.correction: The test paired the new apex with old-origin data and ignored a 15 m ground fall to 8th Ave; implied roof 43 m ASL is about 27 m above ground.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Higher Buildings Policy supplies height caps to include in the minimum surface.
falseAssumptions.correction: It is a relaxation: Higher Buildings may enter QE view 3 and named corridors; heights are approximate guidance. PVG 3.4.2 lets Exceptional Downtown Sites also enter B1, B2, D, 12.2.

falseAssumptions.claim: The checker's three outcomes CLEAR, BOUNDARY and INTERSECTS are exhaustive.
falseAssumptions.correction: A wedge without calibrated parameters needs IN CONE - NO ESTIMATE; CLEAR is allowed only when every covering wedge is estimated and clear.

falseAssumptions.claim: The far edge of each cone is a clip near Burrard Inlet, and all 24 cones are triangles.
falseAssumptions.correction: Cone 28 has five vertices; K looks south to City Hall and its far edge is the subject boundary.

falseAssumptions.claim: The service's 2026-04-15 'data edit' shows the cone geometry was edited.
falseAssumptions.correction: dataLastEditDate equals schemaLastEditDate to the millisecond (1776247144052); use geometry and attribute hashes as the only edit evidence.

falseAssumptions.claim: The water aerodrome AC 601-007 notification surface is 60 m AGL.
falseAssumptions.correction: 60 m AGL applies only without a defined water channel. With defined channels the aerodrome is runway-type (4.7(2)), 2% to 3,000 m; the heliport 4% surface is stated for heliports with instrument approach in 4.5.4 but generally in 4.5(1)(c).

falseAssumptions.claim: The worst penetration point is the point nearest the origin.
falseAssumptions.correction: Penetration is the maximum over the clipped geometry of z - Z(x, y); under the radial rule it can fall at the foot of the perpendicular on an edge, or inside a sloped face.

falseAssumptions.claim: Trout Lake 27.1 and 27.2 have published lower-boundary parameters (59.8 m and 54.3 m at 495340.12, 5456431.39).
falseAssumptions.correction: 59.8 and 54.3 m are in force, measured from the 1975 E 12th NE corner (parcel vertex 495332.94, 5456355.10). The printed coordinates belong to proposed 27.2 at 2670 Victoria Dr (68.9 m, not adopted).

falseAssumptions.claim: View 20's lower-boundary reference is a building in West Vancouver, so it is roof-aligned (S3).
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat it as terrain-referenced (S5): the 2024 definition is the uppermost extent of the 'English Properties' in West Vancouver, a hillside about 11 km north; the earlier boundary was the roof of 1763 Comox St.

falseAssumptions.claim: View H's 58 m (Dec 2025) conflicts with the 2011 reference (40.64 m at 982.77 m), so H cannot be classed S1; Table 1 shows H unamended.
falseAssumptions.correction: The 2011 H1 reference (corner of 501 Keefer St) is superseded. Appendix K sets H to 58 m at the Sun Yat-Sen pavilion; Council endorsed it 16 Dec 2025 (Rec K, vote 11268). Table 1 lacks the label.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vista README: origins can only be estimated from polygon geometry.
falseAssumptions.correction: The polygon apex is the City's origin coordinate; sibling cones share it exactly and the City layer adds Lv.

falseAssumptions.claim: Whether view 12.2 was dropped or its Table 1 row omitted cannot be told; the change shows only in the Feb 2026 PDF.
falseAssumptions.correction: Council deleted the row on 4 June 2025 (RTS 16361 App C); the Jun 2025 PDF already lacks it and 3.4.2's mention is vestigial.

falseAssumptions.claim: YVR or harbour obstacle surfaces cap downtown heights.
falseAssumptions.correction: YVR zoning (SOR/80-902) covers Richmond lands only; no zoning found for the harbour aerodrome or heliport.

falseAssumptions.claim: int16 centimetre terrain tiles suit all terrain.
falseAssumptions.correction: int16 cm caps at 327.67 m; North Shore peaks reach about 1,700 m. Use uint16 with offset: cm for the CBD, dm for regional tiles.

falseAssumptions.claim: 13 City LiDAR 2022 tiles lie within 2 km of downtown.
falseAssumptions.correction: 20 tiles intersect a 2 km circle around the Vista anchor; 13 intersect a 1.5 km circle. Plain scripted requests get HTTP 403.

falseAssumptions.claim: A City-DTM-minus-converted-HRDEM median of 0.15 m or less demonstrates correct datum handling.
falseAssumptions.correction: The expected CGVD2013-CGVD28 shift is about 0.12 m, so an unconverted layer also passes. Require 0.03 m or less on hard surfaces, plus a negative test on the unconverted data.

falseAssumptions.claim: All elevation sources can be merged without datum work.
falseAssumptions.correction: City LiDAR is CGVD28GVRD; HRDEM and MRDEM are CGVD2013; SRTM is EGM96; GLO-30 is EGM2008; OSM heights are relative.

falseAssumptions.claim: City DTM minus converted HRDEM within 0.03 m demonstrates that the team's HTMVBC00 chain is correct.
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat the 2013 bridge as a diagnostic showing which model NRCan used. Accept the chain against GeoNetBC monuments, with both predicted residual grids (HTMVBC00 and HT2) computed.

falseAssumptions.claim: City LiDAR 2022 heights use the HTGVRDBC00 hybrid geoid.
falseAssumptions.correction: Portal metadata names the Metro Vancouver Geoid HTMVBC00 (HTMVBC00_Abbbyn.zip). GeoBC: HTMVBC00 equals HTGVRDBC00 extended east to Abbotsford; LTSA approves HTGVRDBC00 in Metro Vancouver.

falseAssumptions.claim: City building-footprint datasets carry height fields.
falseAssumptions.correction: Only the 2009 set has elevations and heights, as roof-facet rows under 2009 conditions; 2015 and 1999 sets are geometry only.

falseAssumptions.claim: Default attribution for City layers should be 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - British Columbia.'
falseAssumptions.correction: Use 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Vancouver' with a link to the City licence page for City layers; the OGL-BC string only for provincial layers; the OGL-Canada string for NRCan layers.

falseAssumptions.claim: EPSG:26910 is NAD83(CSRS) UTM zone 10N.
falseAssumptions.correction: 26910 is NAD83 (original); NAD83(CSRS) / UTM 10N is EPSG:3157. City LiDAR states NAD83(CSRS) 4.0.0.BC.1.GVRD.

falseAssumptions.claim: Google Open Buildings can supply Vancouver footprints.
falseAssumptions.correction: Coverage is Africa, South and South-East Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean; Canada is not listed and the page names no height field.

falseAssumptions.claim: HRDEM BC-Lower_Mainland_2016-1m (bbox to 49.5125 N) gives 1 m terrain and skyline for the North Shore front ranges (M05 R2).
falseAssumptions.correction: A bbox is an envelope. The extent polygon (351 vertices, 2 parts) excludes Grouse, Seymour, Crown, Cypress, Lions samples; HRDEM mosaic DTM is null at Grouse and Seymour; LidarBC has no point-cloud tile there. Ridge terrain is MRDEM-30, GLO-30-derived.

falseAssumptions.claim: HTMVBC00 and CGG2013a can be combined as H28 = H2013 + N_CGG2013a - N_HTMVBC00 through one ellipsoidal height, with epoch mixing only a residual note.
falseAssumptions.correction: Add an NAD83(CSRS) velocity step from the layer epoch to 1997.0 (ca_nrc_NAD83v70VG) before applying N_HTMVBC00; report its size over the AOI; record horizontal and vertical epochs as separate registry fields.

falseAssumptions.claim: If view 3.2.1 is 123.201 m geodetic (Barclay), 361 ft at Thurlow/Haro implies City DTM there is about 13 m +/- 1 m.
falseAssumptions.correction: The two values come from different sites and possibly different editions, and it is unknown whether 361 ft is above grade. HRDEM DTM near 1045 Haro is about 40.7 m, not 13 m.

falseAssumptions.claim: OGL-Vancouver may be 'viral' (share-alike), so City layers cannot be combined (M08).
falseAssumptions.correction: The 2011 commentary predates the current licence. OGL-Vancouver is reported as OGL-BC 2.0 with the name replaced; the OGL-BC 2.0 text read is attribution-only. Share-alike comes from ODbL.

falseAssumptions.claim: Offsets between Vista and UTM grid coordinates measure Vista's own frame distortion.
falseAssumptions.correction: They include UTM grid convergence (-0.0915 deg at the anchor: 6.3 m of easting over 3.94 km due north) and scale 0.9996. Against local true-north ENU the error at (0,3940) is E 0.0, N +22.9 m.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 3D BAG median RMSE (0.31 m flat, 1.06 m non-flat) is a benchmark for tower height error versus published heights.
falseAssumptions.correction: It is the point-cloud-to-block geometric difference including wall points: a block-fit metric, not height accuracy. Its flat class has about 2.5 m median height (sheds, garages).

falseAssumptions.claim: The City publishes DEM or DSM products derived from 2018 and 2022 LiDAR.
falseAssumptions.correction: 2018 and 2022 are zipped LAS tiles only; the only City raster DEM is the 2013 1 m GeoTIFF (1.91 GB).

falseAssumptions.claim: The local difference between HTMVBC00 and national HTv2.0 is unquantifiable because HTMVBC00 is not in PROJ.
falseAssumptions.correction: GeoBC publishes HTMVBC00 as a 37.5 KB BYN and GDAL reads BYN, so the difference is computable and HTMVBC00 can be used directly in the chain.

falseAssumptions.claim: View 3.2.1 was amended in 2024, so the Barclay edition and datum may differ.
falseAssumptions.correction: 3.2.1 is unchanged since 1989. 12.1.1 is absent from the 24 current references, so the Barclay document uses the pre-2024 numbering.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vista README: terrain is '60 m SRTM'.
falseAssumptions.correction: SRTM 1 arc-second (about 30.9 x 20.1 m cells) sampled at 60 m (extension) and 300 m (backdrop), EGM96; supplied-model terrain source and datum are unrecorded.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vista's frame differs from UTM by about 5 m at 2.5 km; a generic projection effect, fine for visuals.
falseAssumptions.correction: Cause is a wrong latitude constant (110,574 vs 111,215.2 m/deg, 0.58% short) plus 0.19% short longitude scale. Offsets reach 21 m at the north edge of the supplied model and 34 m at the SE corner; 14 m at 2.5 km north.

falseAssumptions.claim: A .reuse/dep5 file is the way to map data paths to licences (critique fix)
falseAssumptions.correction: Use REUSE.toml [[annotations]] with path globs plus LICENSES/ files.

falseAssumptions.claim: BC Assessment values are open data
falseAssumptions.correction: Use City property tax report under OGL-Vancouver. (r2: the report lists BC Assessment as co-owner; the row now records data_owner and asks the City to confirm.)

falseAssumptions.claim: City portal offers canopy rasters and traffic volumes
falseAssumptions.correction: Derive canopy from LiDAR; mark volumes unresolved.

falseAssumptions.claim: City tree data has a height-range field
falseAssumptions.correction: Use height_m, but treat as class midpoints: 84 values, ten classes hold 95.6%.

falseAssumptions.claim: City tree heights are 10 ft class values with +/-1.5 m uncertainty (all records)
falseAssumptions.correction: Record height_mode (ft_class, metre_value, other, suspect); apply +/-1.5 m to ft_class only; flag 40 m or above, or above the CHM at the point plus a margin, and exclude suspect heights from shade studies by default.

falseAssumptions.claim: Cl. 3.1.5 sets a 2 m encroachment tolerance against which datum error is 'far below'
falseAssumptions.correction: Massing tolerance is 0 m. Carry datum, LiDAR, footprint and georeference errors as an uncertainty band; return clear, within_uncertainty or encroaches. Cite 3.1.5 only for rooftop-element warnings with its hardship condition.

falseAssumptions.claim: Council reports and guideline PDFs carry no licence terms, so a facts-only id suffices
falseAssumptions.correction: Use LicenseRef-CoV-ToU-noncommercial with redistribution noncommercial_notice (documents) or facts_only (transcribed numbers); store citations, not PDF text or figures.

falseAssumptions.claim: EPSG:6647 is the code for current CGVD2013 heights
falseAssumptions.correction: Register 9245 and 6647; record geoid realisation (CGG2013 versus CGG2013a) per layer. (r3: also register 20034 and 20035 and match the epoch to each layer's NAD83(CSRS) version.)

falseAssumptions.claim: Git LFS can hold Pages data
falseAssumptions.correction: Build in CI and deploy by artifact; no LFS.

falseAssumptions.claim: GitHub Pages serves any file with usable range requests
falseAssumptions.correction: Probe every extension; default to whole-file GETs up to 20 MB; shard or use another host if probes fail. (Superseded r1: the gzip-bytes claim was wrong for browsers; see next range flag.)

falseAssumptions.claim: LidarBC is licensed OGL-BC (no qualification)
falseAssumptions.correction: Record both, set status licence_conflict, ask LiDAR@gov.bc.ca and check per-tile metadata before deriving or shipping any LidarBC product.

falseAssumptions.correction: Record EPSG:3979, CGVD2013, project id per tile; range-read COGs offline or in CI.

falseAssumptions.correction: Gate range_safe on a Playwright browser probe; Firefox and WebKit untested. Whole-file GETs still gain from gzip. Browser HEAD returns gzip Content-Length, so pass byteLength from the manifest.

falseAssumptions.claim: Outside Downtown solar rule covers spring and fall equinoxes; Downtown times are PDT (from council drafts RTS 16338 App C and RTS 16506 App A)

falseAssumptions.claim: ParcelMap BC Parcel Polygons (open) are NAD83(CSRS)

falseAssumptions.correction: Measured r3 at 16 parcels (388 vertex pairs, plain GRS80 Albers, no transform): median dE -0.005 m, dN -0.018 m, per-vertex median 0.44 m. Apply no shift between ParcelMap and City parcels; cite the measurement, not the statistic. Limits: small sample, shared source fabric possible.

falseAssumptions.claim: Portal data_processed signals a content change, so it can trigger rebuilds and update toasts
falseAssumptions.correction: Trigger on modified plus the sha256 of the normalised export; use the change-log as a hint only.

falseAssumptions.claim: Portal lon/lat labelled WGS84 are WGS84 values
falseAssumptions.correction: Label NAD83(CSRS) (EPSG:4617/3157); write PROJJSON crs; declare any transform to true WGS84 (EPSG lists 1-2 m).

falseAssumptions.claim: RTS 18292 App A gives 27.2 Current 54.3 m with UTM X 495,340.12 Y 5,456,431.39
falseAssumptions.correction: 27.2 Current 54.3 m (178 ft) from the NE corner of 1975 E 12th Ave, no published coordinates (derived E 495,332.94 N 5,456,355.10, labelled derived). 27.2 Proposed 68.9 m from 2670 Victoria Dr, X 495,340.12 Y 5,456,431.39. Column-position check added to every transcription.

falseAssumptions.claim: Rapid transit stations layer = 22 stations
falseAssumptions.correction: Count deduplicated stations; add planned stations separately (BC government: six new stations, fall 2027).

falseAssumptions.claim: Release assets can feed the browser viewer
falseAssumptions.correction: Use releases for archives and CI; serve browser data from Pages.

falseAssumptions.claim: SOR/80-902 parameters (45 m above a 2 m ARP, about 47 m; 1:50; 1:7) are enough to generate the YVR height ceiling
falseAssumptions.correction: Obtain plans and the proposed-limit map; keep the layer 'unconfirmed' and out of compliance warnings.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 10 builds/hour soft limit constrains the deploy design

falseAssumptions.claim: The adopted Public Views Guidelines PDF may hold per-view cone heights, geometry or diagrams (222 KB listing)
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat every numeric cone height as unconfirmed with status and evidence; cite the adopted PDF only for clause text and the view list.

falseAssumptions.claim: TransLink data is open under an OGL

falseAssumptions.claim: Vista's central context is credited correctly, with OSM credit needed only for buildings outside the supplied model
falseAssumptions.correction: Do not inherit the export, terrain, water or shoreline until written supplier permission and an ODbL classification exist; credit '(c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL' for the central model in Vista; add the basemap to the lineage audit; otherwise rebuild from City footprints, LiDAR and class 5 water.

falseAssumptions.claim: 828 Cambie lies 0.19 m outside cone A; state: near edge.
falseAssumptions.correction: The parcel is inside plan and height decides; the address point stays only as the P828 frame fixture; the Site port tests polygons only.

falseAssumptions.claim: A UTM 10 grid agrees with the Vincenty GRS80 inverse within 0.1 m and 0.01 deg on QE to Barclay, so EPSG:3157 kernels meet 0.05 m and 0.001 deg.
falseAssumptions.correction: Run containment wholly in the grid; take reported distances and azimuths from GeographicLib; never mix. After mean-scale and convergence correction the grid matches the geodesic within 0.0001 m and 0.0001 deg.

falseAssumptions.claim: A cone limit is one flat height per cone (H0 default), with no published slope.
falseAssumptions.correction: Default planar L = Lv + s D; flat L is T0 only; s from T1a fits or T1b references.

falseAssumptions.claim: A far plane of 8 km is enough for the camera rig.
falseAssumptions.correction: Far plane at least 60 km with reversed-Z or log depth; test that every Table 1 subject renders.

falseAssumptions.claim: A per-cone ENU frame can replace EPSG:3157 for the exceedance test.
falseAssumptions.correction: Plan coordinates in EPSG:3157; z always orthometric in the datum of the limit; ENU only as a render frame with the shared drop function.

falseAssumptions.claim: Cone 22's lower boundary references the roof at 183 Terminal Ave.
falseAssumptions.correction: The reference for 22 is 210 E 5th Ave (2024 text); 183 Terminal is the earlier text.

falseAssumptions.claim: First-user designs sit on real downtown sites, where the cone test applies directly.
falseAssumptions.correction: Entrant checks are what-if location studies: hypothetical-site mode, live headroom while dragging, a HeadroomMap, and a Buildner Q and A question before 3 Nov.

falseAssumptions.claim: Footprints-2009 elevations have no stated datum.
falseAssumptions.correction: Record geodetic, likely CGVD28 (unconfirmed); 2009-era and approximate, so a third source in the roof spread.

falseAssumptions.claim: HRDEM covers the North Shore peaks (inferred from the item bbox).
falseAssumptions.correction: Use MRDEM-30 (30 m, CGVD2013, Copernicus attribution) for the backdrop; its DSM maxima sit 8-96 m below published summits.

falseAssumptions.claim: LiDAR-2022 accuracy is 0.081 m at 95% on open ground.
falseAssumptions.correction: Write 0.081 m at 95% (land cover and standard not stated); measure roof z against reference points before relying on sub-metre roof limits.

falseAssumptions.claim: No local high-resolution terrain is confirmed; origin elevations must come from SRTM, HRDEM or LidarBC.
falseAssumptions.correction: LiDAR-2022 is the primary source for origin z, grade and roofs; HRDEM and SRTM serve only the North Shore backdrop. (r3: HRDEM has no data at the peaks; MRDEM-30 serves the backdrop.)

falseAssumptions.claim: Origin geodetic elevations and the City eye height are not published.
falseAssumptions.correction: Eye z = City Lv (quality Q1); datum unstated; values rounded; structures (E, G, 10, K) need offsets.

falseAssumptions.claim: Polygon geometry of each cone is enough to estimate maximum building height at every location.
falseAssumptions.correction: Polygons give plan extent only; limits come from tiers T1a, T1b or T2 (M04) with an estimate flag; ask views@vancouver.ca.

falseAssumptions.claim: SRTM is accurate enough for origin elevations.
falseAssumptions.correction: Use LiDAR-2022 for origins; keep SRTM only as a distant backdrop fallback.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 0.56 s check on 1 M triangles was measured on a desktop CPU.
falseAssumptions.correction: Relabelled as a high-end laptop figure; targets are 1 s high-end and 3 s thin laptops, to be measured.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 1008 Cambie roof (102.68 m, 2009) lies within 3 m of the published cone A limit (105.71 m), supporting T1b.
falseAssumptions.correction: T1b is unvalidated; calibrate with T1a points; test LiDAR-2022 maximum-angle roofs first.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 13 Nov MVP fits in 11.5 person-days.
falseAssumptions.correction: MVP shares: M01 1.5, M02 2, M04 6.5, M05 1, M06 1, M07 2, M08 1 = 15.0 person-days; 14.0 without the 5 m grade field.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 2026-02-04 Public Views Guidelines text is unread by the team.
falseAssumptions.correction: Recover the team copy, hash it, compare with 597f0da2, diff against 79d5face and 54cf65e8, and have a named member sign guidelines.lock.json.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Buildner answer on AI-generated images is unread and unknown.
falseAssumptions.correction: AI images are not banned; record the tool and its terms. (r3: the Brief itself is read and silent on AI.)

falseAssumptions.claim: The City 2004 sheet has 6 rows and all were recomputed exactly.
falseAssumptions.correction: Six rows recompute exactly (validation cases); rows are 1995-99 history, not current parameters; other rows have blank cells in the extract.

falseAssumptions.claim: The HeadroomMap governing limit is the cone with the smallest L + U95.
falseAssumptions.correction: Two surfaces, min(L - U95) and min(L + U95), minus grade; per-cone cards stay authoritative.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Tall Challenge Brief was not read (email sign-up needed).
falseAssumptions.correction: Ask Buildner only whether cones bind the site; no AI rule is in the Brief text.

falseAssumptions.claim: The real lower boundary slopes, so a flat ceiling drifts about 36 m per km for every cone.
falseAssumptions.correction: Per-cone hypotheses: H0 flat (default) and H1 sloped, fitted with s = 0 allowed; the 36 m per km figure is deleted. (Superseded in r3: slope is per cone, 0.4 m per km for 3.2.3 and 58.9 m per km for A.)

falseAssumptions.claim: Vista frame distances and bearings are correct: Barclay 4.56 km at 347.3 deg; 828 Cambie at 47.14 deg on the cone A edge.
falseAssumptions.correction: GRS80 geodesic: 1060 Barclay 4,596-4,639 m at 346.90-347.24 deg; cone A sector 43.28-47.02 deg; 828 Cambie address point 1,704.8 m at 47.031 deg, 0.19 m outside (the parcel overlaps, see r3).

falseAssumptions.claim: A 2 m tolerance derives the status of the 1880 Main St check, and its element was a rooftop amenity.
falseAssumptions.correction: checks[] store measured max, average and area only. The 2 m sits in reference_provision (clause, source, applies unknown) and never decides status; element_kind stays unknown unless the report names it.

falseAssumptions.claim: A GeoNetBC monument reproduced by own code is independent datum control, and its coordinates may sit in the packet.
falseAssumptions.correction: It tests only the projection code. GeoNetBC's high-precision layer is Access Only, so monument coordinates are removed. The test now uses the OS Guide's published Airy 1830 vector; the independent horizontal check remains the ParcelMap BC polygon.

falseAssumptions.claim: A parcel corner matching council UTM values within 0.11 m shows that portal lon/lat are NAD83(CSRS).
falseAssumptions.correction: The match is circular: both are City-sourced. Independent check: City Library Square vertices sit within 0.02 to 0.15 m of the Province's ParcelMap BC polygon. The realisation stays unconfirmed.

falseAssumptions.claim: A single ceiling value (views.ceiling.height_m; Vista boundary 80 m) is the cone limit for a site.
falseAssumptions.correction: The ceiling is a located surface: sub-sections, each with its own maximum height (City public-views page), horizontal within a sub-section per Guidelines s.2, stored with reference points and evaluated by exact clipping (r3).

falseAssumptions.claim: Buildings built after 2009 can be found by non-overlap with the 2009 parts and the 2015 footprints.
falseAssumptions.correction: Detect change per part from LiDAR 2022 (|dz| > 2 m), flag permits issued since 2017, and label the pack city_2009_snapshot until that is done. Non-overlap finds only buildings on empty ground.

falseAssumptions.claim: CGVD28_HTMVBC00 is a vertical datum value.
falseAssumptions.correction: CGVD28 is the datum; HTMVBC00 and HTGVRDBC00 are hybrid geoid models. Layer 0 stores datum, geoid_model and epoch separately; same datum with a different geoid model gives review, not unknown.

falseAssumptions.claim: CityJSON export can use EPSG:3157 plus EPSG:5713 as one reference system.
falseAssumptions.correction: metadata.referenceSystem takes one OGC Name Type URL. No registered compound of UTM 10N and CGVD28 was found; EPSG:6653 is UTM 10N + CGVD2013. Export EPSG:3157 with the datum in a +vtm member, or 6653 after a logged GPS-H conversion.

falseAssumptions.claim: Context building heights must come from OSM tags or estimates (PVV subset 24% measured), with terrain from 60 m SRTM.
falseAssumptions.correction: Primary sources: City building-footprints-2009 (124,181 LiDAR parts with geodetic top and base, bldgid groups) and LiDAR 2022 (0.081 m vertical) plus the 1 m DEM. OSM only for buildings after 2009; SRTM beyond City coverage.

falseAssumptions.claim: DT Mass works in local metres from the parcel south-west corner, and its view-cone copy is only suspected.
falseAssumptions.correction: DT Mass has a fixed city frame: origin (-123.118, 49.283), scale [72,616.63, 110,574]; its city-data.js holds 17 view cones, 6,319 City 2009 footprints, 272 zoning polygons, 4,348 parcels.

falseAssumptions.claim: Four or more distinct rhino3dm builds ship across Vista, Form Studio, Solar and DT Mass.
falseAssumptions.correction: Three builds: Vista 8.35.0, Form Studio and DT Mass (byte-identical, npm 8.17.0), Solar 8.4.0.

falseAssumptions.claim: Height-bearing objects are covered by vertical on Massing, ViewStudy, ContextRef and ceilings; floors need no reference.
falseAssumptions.correction: floors[].tower_id equals a massing part id and elevation_m is relative to that part's vertical.grade_z_m; the validator rejects floors with no resolvable grade.

falseAssumptions.claim: Layer 0 heights can be compared with view-cone ceilings without declaring a vertical datum.
falseAssumptions.correction: Every height-bearing object carries vertical{datum, grade_z_m, grade_source}; comparisons return unknown unless datums match. City LiDAR is CGVD28 (Metro Vancouver geoid); EGM96 for SRTM; Vista and Form Studio z are model-relative or assumed.

falseAssumptions.claim: Layer 0 lon/lat can be treated as WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) as in GeoJSON.
falseAssumptions.correction: Portal lon/lat equal NAD83(CSRS) coordinates (parcel corner within 0.11 m of council UTM values); true WGS 84 (ITRF) differs by about 2 m. Layer 0 declares NAD83(CSRS) as served and flags GNSS or WGS 84 inputs.

falseAssumptions.claim: Only view 10's object_id changed (3 in Vista, 1 live).
falseAssumptions.correction: object_id changed for 19 of 24 cones; all 24 polygons are identical to Vista's snapshot.

falseAssumptions.claim: PVV's .b64.txt can be deleted from the Pages build without further change.
falseAssumptions.correction: app.js loads manifest.file_b64 in preference to the .bin, and build_pages.py copies the whole basemap/ folder. Choose the file per host (manifest flag or build step) and test the Map tab on Pages before removal.

falseAssumptions.claim: PVV's README floor-list example (programme ids O1 and T4) can be imported, and templates/ holds CSV and JSON templates.
falseAssumptions.correction: O1 and T4 are value-row ids; the importer throws unknown programme. Valid ids come from the catalogue (WK1, SE1, AM4). templates/ holds only .gitkeep; the CSV template is a string at app.js line 859.

falseAssumptions.claim: PVV's floor record can be adopted unchanged with optional tower_id and plan_ref, and a Layer 0 floors array imports into PVV unchanged.
falseAssumptions.correction: floors[] is unique on (tower_id, level). PVV throws on repeated levels and drops extra keys, so its adapter filters one tower or aggregates, and foreign fields round-trip through the host or ext.pvv.

falseAssumptions.claim: Renaming block to conflict and forbidding pass on non-cited ceilings keeps the Form Studio round trip at zero changed fields, and all its checks carry clause and sourceUrl.
falseAssumptions.correction: The adapter needs an explicit status crosswalk (block to conflict, review to review, pass to pass for non-ceiling checks) with the original kept in ext.form_studio. Only some checks (VBBL, view-cones) carry clause, sourceUrl and verifiedOn.

falseAssumptions.claim: SRTM is the only terrain source beyond City LiDAR and can stand in for ground.
falseAssumptions.correction: NRCan HRDEM 1 m DTM covers Vancouver and the North Shore (CGVD2013). SRTM is a surface model: 41.0 m at Shangri-La against 30.7 to 31.0 m City base.

falseAssumptions.claim: Switching to EPSG:3157 brings distance and area error within the 0.05% target.
falseAssumptions.correction: UTM scale factor near Vancouver is 0.99960087: distances 0.040% short, areas 0.080% short. Use a local TM with k=1 as working frame; keep EPSG:3157 for exchange.

falseAssumptions.claim: The City's view-cone object_id is a stable key (Vista stores object_id 3 for view 10).
falseAssumptions.correction: The live API returns object_id 1 for view 10. Key cones on view_number plus a polygon hash.

falseAssumptions.claim: The February 2026 edition of the Public Views Guidelines is unavailable, so only the June 2025 edition could be read.
falseAssumptions.correction: Vista data/guideline.json holds s.2 p.3 text, clauses 3.1.1 to 3.1.5 (pp.6-7) and Table 1 of the 4 Feb 2026 edition (accessed 2026-09-22); the PDF sits in the private project, hash pending.

falseAssumptions.claim: The M01 inventory of storage keys and libraries was complete, and 'under 1 MB' is one limit.
falseAssumptions.correction: Added pvv-help-seen, pvv-money-book-edition, vtt-draft, qrcodejs 1.0.0 (cdnjs), Google Fonts in the toolbench, the IS_PUBLIC switch and Solar's EPW files. The caps are 1,000,000 B (Form Studio) and 1,048,576 B (Vista); Layer 0 uses 1,000,000 B.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Orthophotos_2022 licence is not shown and its terms are unverified.
falseAssumptions.correction: The open-data dataset orthophoto-imagery-2022 is OGL-Vancouver, EPSG:26910, 7.5 cm, captured 6 June to 1 July 2022. Only the ArcGIS tile endpoint's own terms remain unconfirmed.

falseAssumptions.claim: The PVV downtown basemap is an ODbL derived OSM database and the clean template for Layer 0 building packs.
falseAssumptions.correction: build_basemap.py reads Vista's unified_buildings.bin (9,897 buildings from the supplied studio model), plus its parks and roads. Treat the basemap like Vista's packs: owner and terms unknown, uncleared; keep the layout as a format template only.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Solar tool's weather data size is unknown and lives in src/data/hourly.js.
falseAssumptions.correction: weather/ holds two NRC EPW files (1,588,114 B and 1,587,269 B); hourly.js (94,029 B) is derived from them by tools/hourly.mjs.

falseAssumptions.claim: The four tools share three.js, Leaflet and rhino3dm.
falseAssumptions.correction: Only Form Studio ships three.js (r128) and Leaflet (1.9.4). Vista renders with its own WebGL2; PVV and the toolbench use neither. rhino3dm appears as different builds in Vista and Form Studio.

falseAssumptions.claim: The local frame is accurate because eight OSM footprints match within 0.08 m (Vista data/geo.json).
falseAssumptions.correction: The check shows the Rhino model was built with the same formula, not agreement with the ground. Scale is 0.58% short N-S and 0.19% short E-W; areas are 0.77% small.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vista data/guideline.json has SHA-256 5c214a50 (12,337 B); viewcones.json is 37,707 B; example-study.json is 25,508 B; vancouver-sites.js is 296,947 B.
falseAssumptions.correction: Committed and served bytes: guideline.json 12,062 B, SHA-256 51ba7ee7...; viewcones.json 36,357 B; example-study.json 24,624 B; vancouver-sites.js 296,943 B. Hash git show HEAD:path or the Pages response; add .gitattributes.

falseAssumptions.claim: ceilingAt() evaluated at every footprint vertex and roof sample finds every cone penetration, and 'outside a known sub-section' means unknown.
falseAssumptions.correction: Prisms are clipped exactly against sub-section and cone polygons; sampling is for meshes only. ceilingAt returns none (outside every dataset cone), unknown (inside a cone, no known ceiling) or a value.

falseAssumptions.claim: About 46 person-days are available to 13 Nov 2026 (2 students x 23 days).
falseAssumptions.correction: 21 Oct to 13 Nov holds 18 weekdays, so 36 person-days at full time, fewer with other courses. P01 core is capped at about 7 person-days; the integrator must publish a cross-packet budget.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M01 and P01-M07: The brief rules (244-305 m band, 9.0 non-residential FSR, site size, transit entrance) are 'verified'.
falseAssumptions.correction: Downgraded to unverified (the two core metrics are marked false_assumption_corrected). The team registers by 29 Oct 2026, downloads the brief and cites page and clause for each rule.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M01 and P01-M07: The brief rules (244-305 m band, 9.0 non-residential FSR, site size, transit entrance) are verified.
falseAssumptions.correction: Downgraded to unverified (two core metrics marked false_assumption_corrected). The team registers by 29 Oct 2026, downloads the brief and cites page, clause and sentence for each rule.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M02 has no upstream dependency, so the Kahn check over depends_on guarantees an acyclic graph.
falseAssumptions.correction: M02 is now static data only. Block lookups (large-sites trigger, residential permission, policy-area membership) moved to new P01-M10, which depends on M02, M07 and M09. Site area is owned by M09. CI adds a lint that every P01-Mxx named in inputs or method appears in depends_on.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M02/M08: The large-sites policy thresholds (0.8 ha / 45,000 m2) and the CBD residential restriction are reviewer recollections with no sourced evidence.
falseAssumptions.correction: Both have public evidence, seen only as search summaries because City hosts return 403: the policy applies at a site of 8,000 m2 or more OR 45,000 m2 or more of new floor area; a 2022 Council report says residential use is not permitted in DODP Area A. The block meets both triggers. r3: the Area A item stays amber until a person opens the source.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M02: 'Sites inside the policy area, buildings up to 600 ft may be considered' is a verified, general threshold.
falseAssumptions.correction: Policy heights are site-specific (policy Figure 1). 600 ft (183 m) is verified only for the sites immediately across the street from Bay Parkade; elsewhere it is unverified. M02 now stores a lookup, status unverified until the PDF is read.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M02: Inside a transit-oriented area residential parking minimums are zero, but commercial parking may still be required (TOA is the operative parking rule).
falseAssumptions.correction: Vancouver removed minimum vehicle parking for all land uses citywide in June 2024 (downtown earlier). Accessible, visitor, bicycle, loading and passenger-loading requirements remain; Downtown ODP maximums apply. TOA status is context only.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M02: Sites inside the policy area, buildings up to 600 ft may be considered is a verified, general threshold.
falseAssumptions.correction: Policy heights are site-specific (Figure 1). 600 ft (183 m) is verified only for the sites immediately across the street from Bay Parkade; elsewhere unverified. A lookup is stored, status unverified until the PDF is read.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M04: Cone status can be tagged by checking the open-data cone id against the Storeys retained/updated/eliminated list.
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat the City open data (modified 19 Oct 2026) as the in-force geometry; build a crosswalk from the Public Views Guidelines (hand-read); Storeys for history only; unmatched IDs are unknown.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M04: Pre-2024 cone data overstates restriction for the QEP tests.
falseAssumptions.correction: Record retained, updated or eliminated per cone. For retained QEP cones 3.2.1-3.2.4 pre-2024 geometry may be unchanged: accept it with an 'unverified, confirm unchanged' badge. Do not test eliminated cones.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M05 and key findings: Above 150 m AGL daytime marking is always required for every VTC tower, and strobe-type lights are not recommended in urban areas.
falseAssumptions.correction: Day marking is required above 150 m AGL with red and with medium-intensity white (CL-865) systems, but may be omitted with high-intensity white, or dual systems using high-intensity white, at any height. High-intensity white near residences may need an environmental evaluation and glare shielding. The urban strobe note covers CL-865 units. Transport Canada decides.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M05: NAV CANADA replies take 12-18 months near airports.
falseAssumptions.correction: Quote the conditional wording; base the metric on whether a request was logged at concept stage; add the Transport Canada Aeronautical Assessment Form (at least 90 days before construction) as a separate checklist item.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M05: The YVR zoning surface penetration metric is 'verified' for this tower.
falseAssumptions.correction: Formula verified; applicability to downtown unknown (probably outside current zoning). The July 2026 proposal adds an area to the 2024 one and its surfaces are unpublished.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M05: The YVR zoning surface penetration metric is verified for this tower.
falseAssumptions.correction: Formula verified; applicability to downtown unknown (probably outside current zoning). The July 2026 proposal adds an area to the 2024 one and its surfaces are unpublished.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M05: The precedent screening flag is 288 m above grade.
falseAssumptions.correction: 288 m is a display marker labelled 'height measure unstated' in the height ladder of P01-M08; it is not a threshold and not on M05's pass/fail cards.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M08: Bay Parkade is a usable benchmark for a VTC employment-led tower.
falseAssumptions.correction: Use Bay Parkade only for height beyond policy, aviation risk and benefit scale. Show a precedent-fit note (program, policy-area status, height measure). Never use it for the program mix or the 9.0 non-residential test.

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M08: Mapping benefits to 'cash CAC' is a verified Vancouver Charter statutory mapping (ss. 565.1, 565.13).
falseAssumptions.correction: Five separate categories: in-kind condition (s.565(1)(f.1), s.565.17), payment in lieu of density-bonus conditions (s.565.13), DCL (s.523D), ACC (s.523E, in-kind s.523M), and policy-based CAC (negotiated; status 'policy, unverified').

falseAssumptions.claim: P01-M08: Mapping benefits to cash CAC is a verified Vancouver Charter statutory mapping (ss. 565.1, 565.13).
falseAssumptions.correction: Five categories: in-kind condition (s.565(1)(f.1), s.565.17), payment in lieu (s.565.13), DCL (s.523D), ACC (s.523E, in-kind s.523M), and policy-based CAC (negotiated; policy, unverified).

falseAssumptions.claim: Quoted brief wording (uses counted, the transit link, public uses extending vertically, the station diagonally across the intersection, a rotated north arrow, the jury rewarding justified breaches) is evidence from S02.
falseAssumptions.correction: Quotation marks removed. Items are labelled extract wording (unquoted) or deleted; the station-across-the-intersection, rotated-north-arrow and rewarded-breach claims were deleted as unsupported. A lint rejects quoted text whose only source is opened=false.

falseAssumptions.claim: The View Protection Guidelines are the governing view policy.
falseAssumptions.correction: Council replaced them with the Public Views Guidelines on 10 Jul 2024: 38 cones cut to 24, view 3.1 removed, 3.2.1-3.2.4 retained. Use post-2024 geometry.

falseAssumptions.claim: The open-data Downtown district sub-area labels can be read directly as the Downtown ODP area letters (A, B, C1, F).
falseAssumptions.correction: A hand-checked crosswalk from open-data labels to ODP letters is required. C and C2 return unknown; A, B and F are letter-identical candidates, unconfirmed. Data vintage 2020-11-19 is stored.

falseAssumptions.claim: 11 Nov 2026 is PST (UTC-8) because daylight saving time ended on Sunday 1 Nov 2026 (r1 calendar computation)
falseAssumptions.correction: British Columbia has been on UTC-7 all year since 8 Mar 2026 (Pacific Time, code PCT); no clocks turn back on 1 Nov 2026, so the 11 Nov wall clock is UTC-7. tzdata 2026b or later gives -7; older tzdata gives -8 and shifts the sun by 15 degrees.

falseAssumptions.claim: A PV-yield 'good' threshold of at least 843 kWh/kWp (south-wall reference) is meaningful for this tower's facades
falseAssumptions.correction: Street-aligned facades face SE/SW/NE/NW: PVGIS-ERA5 vertical yields are SW 823, SE 750, NW 329, NE 273 kWh/kWp. Use azimuth-matched references and relative cut-offs.

falseAssumptions.claim: A SolarEnvelope or robust PASS from the 4 Basic-study instants gives the maximum compliant massing for a continuous 10:00-16:00 window
falseAssumptions.correction: Build the envelope and every compliance result from a swept window (hull of shadows between consecutive instants at most 15 min apart, or continuous azimuth-indexed sun table); keep the 4-instant output only as the Basic study submission sheet, labelled 'format, not compliance'; transcribe per rule whether the City judges instants or the window.

falseAssumptions.claim: A draft source corroborates the approved text: Robson 10:00-15:00, the Sun Yat-Sen absolute rule and the 4-instant Basic study are 'verified_secondary'
falseAssumptions.correction: Use the evidence value 'draft_only' for Robson 10-15 and the Sun Yat-Sen absolute rule, and 'unverified' for the 4-instant Basic study; reserve 'verified_secondary' for content that an opened source states about the approved text.

falseAssumptions.claim: A site-centred disc of radius H / tan(lowest altitude) is a complete baseline context for every M02 output
falseAssumptions.correction: Use the site reach disc plus each in-reach space's sun wedge, with radius (H_max + level difference) / tan(lowest altitude in its window), and print 'baseline incomplete: new shadow overstated (conservative)' where the baseline relies on 2009 footprints or missing approved towers.

falseAssumptions.claim: About 1 km of context captures winter shadows of a 300 m tower (P02-M03 context radius; also reused by P02-M08 for 21 Dec and quoted in P02-M02)
falseAssumptions.correction: Radius = H / tan(minimum solar altitude): about 1.7 km for 300 m at a 10-degree cut-off, 3.4 km at 5 degrees; print the cut-off on every output and optionally apply a far-horizon mask. For the policy windows use the lowest rule altitude: about 0.6 km on 22 Sept, about 1.4 km for 305 m if the 11 Nov wall-clock reading applies.

falseAssumptions.claim: Adoption date of the downtown guidelines is unresolved (July 2025 vs 17 Sept 2025)
falseAssumptions.correction: Approved by Council 17 Sept 2025, last amended 29 July 2026; CDDG effective 27 Oct 2026 (UDI).

falseAssumptions.claim: All Vancouver shadow-policy hours are PDT clock hours
falseAssumptions.correction: 22 Sept rules use PDT (UTC-7); the Remembrance Day cenotaph rule uses PST (UTC-8) on 11 Nov. Store the time zone per rule.

falseAssumptions.claim: City shadow-policy time labels can be taken literally ('PST' means UTC-8), so per-rule offsets can simply come from tzdata
falseAssumptions.correction: Store, per rule, the literal clause zone text, the literal clause UTC offset and the tzdata offset separately; compare them and show a mismatch banner; have a second reader confirm the cenotaph 'PST' wording against the PDF.

falseAssumptions.claim: Downtown rules are organised as Decision Trees A (parks/schools), B (minipark/urban plaza), C (Davie/Robson Village) and clause_ref should point to them
falseAssumptions.correction: Use the guideline clause numbering (ss.3.1-3.3, 4.1-4.3, 5, 6) as the governing key. Decision Trees A-C exist only as three separate one-page companion PDFs that route a user to those clauses.

falseAssumptions.claim: Exceptions are for affordable or social housing, major public amenities such as childcare, or city-building priorities
falseAssumptions.correction: Exception grounds are social housing, below-market rental, a public childcare facility, heritage conservation or a major city-building priority (3.1.2), and need a shadow rationale statement and a 15-minute Detailed study (5.2); staff weigh topography, duration and vulnerable users (3.1.3).

falseAssumptions.claim: Higher Buildings Policy last updated 2018 (or 2011), sites up to 600 ft
falseAssumptions.correction: Policy PDF lists amendments up to 31 Mar 2026 and places the highest buildings (about 700 ft) on West Georgia, Burrard or Granville in the CBD; no numeric shadow criteria; s.2.2 requires Passive House, or TEDI 15 kWh/m2 plus TEUI/GHGI targets and a low-carbon energy system.

falseAssumptions.claim: Ignoring inter-reflections makes radiation results lean conservative
falseAssumptions.correction: Conservative for PV yield only. For overheating (P02-M05) missing reflected gain from glazed neighbours underestimates load; state the bias per use and offer a multi-bounce run.

falseAssumptions.claim: LEED v4.1 credit tiers follow from the plain sDA300/50% of an unshaded model
falseAssumptions.correction: Compute sDA with the operable-shade schedule (2% of sensors at 1,000 lx direct limit, shade transmittance 0.05); 0 credits if it cannot comply; extra credit when every space reaches 55%.

falseAssumptions.claim: Library Square south plaza is an absolute 'no new shadow' special case like Sun Yat-Sen
falseAssumptions.correction: Sun Yat-Sen is the only absolute rule (s.4.1). Dilawri Square South, Jack Poole Plaza and Robson Square are routed to the s.3.1 park rule, which allows exceptions.

falseAssumptions.claim: M02 rules are 'verified' when only an external reviewer's reading of the PDF supports them
falseAssumptions.correction: Every M02 rule is 'verified_secondary' (an opened secondary source agrees on approved text), 'draft_only' (only a superseded draft agrees) or 'unverified' (reviewer relay only) until a team member opens the primary PDF, logs page numbers, cover date and SHA-256, and a second reader confirms Table 1. The build fails if 'verified' lacks that record.

falseAssumptions.claim: Model or site-plan 'up' equals true north, and street-aligned facades face cardinal directions
falseAssumptions.correction: Downtown grid is rotated about 45 degrees from true north (West Georgia about 315 deg, Granville about 045 deg, computed from OSM); the City itself says the downtown grid is rotated and the VTC brief's north arrow is rotated.

falseAssumptions.claim: No sun-hour change at any sensor in City-protected spaces is a 'verified' City criterion across four study dates
falseAssumptions.correction: The City test covers only Table-1 spaces on 22 Sept 10:00-16:00 PT (and 10:00-12:00 PST on 11 Nov for the cenotaph); plazas only minimise. The four-date delta in P02-M03 is a team assumption for design exploration, descriptive only after r2 (no bad badge).

falseAssumptions.claim: NorthFrame (angle CCW from model +Y) is meaningful on any imported model
falseAssumptions.correction: Normalise every import to right-handed Z-up metres first (Y-up needs a +90 degree rotation about X, never a Y/Z swap) and run a blocking named-direction check (Stanley Park NW, BC Place SE, Burrard Inlet N-NE) with the site-plan labels placed in the model frame.

falseAssumptions.claim: PVGIS reference values queried with default settings (r1) are like-for-like with a Radiance/EPW run and with building-integrated facades
falseAssumptions.correction: Compare with the same horizon setting (usehorizon=0 for a model without far terrain, or mask both with the PVGIS profile), convert aspect = azimuth - 180, and use mountingplace=building for BIPV faces.

falseAssumptions.claim: Pinning tzdata 2026b or later at build time guarantees UTC-7 on 11 Nov 2026 for every rule instant
falseAssumptions.correction: Store explicit UTC instants per rule, computed server-side, and never convert local time in the browser; add a runtime assertion that the reading-B instant for 11 Nov 2026 10:00 equals 17:00Z (reading A 18:00Z, 22 Sept 10:00 = 17:00Z) and block M02 on failure.

falseAssumptions.claim: Protected Village sidewalks are tested 10:00-16:00
falseAssumptions.correction: Davie Village 10:00-16:00, Robson Village 10:00-15:00; north sidewalk only, curb to building face.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Radiance licence is the Radiance Software License 1.0
falseAssumptions.correction: Current licence is Radiance Software License Version 2.0 (Radiance v6.1, 1990-2025); use the LBNL-ETA/Radiance repository.

falseAssumptions.claim: The VTC 'SITE PLANS & 3D MODEL' download link is not exposed, so its content must be asked about by the 3 Nov 2026 Q&A deadline
falseAssumptions.correction: The user (a team member) requests the package now with their own email and records its format, north arrow, CRS and context content; it becomes the first-ranked SitePlacement and context source, with candidate blocks justified from the brief's cues.

falseAssumptions.claim: The downtown Solar Access Guidelines were adopted by Council in July 2025 (City landing page 'What's new')
falseAssumptions.correction: Council referred the item back to staff on 23 July 2025; the Standing Committee on Policy and Strategic Priorities heard it on 17 Sept 2025 with the original report plus an updated memo; the guideline PDF is labelled 17 Sept 2025.

falseAssumptions.claim: The shadow baseline is existing plus approved context projected on a flat ground plane
falseAssumptions.correction: Terrain-aware casting with the complete built and approved context including topography, plus known proposed developments as a scenario; trees, public shade structures and small park outbuildings are excluded from the baseline.

falseAssumptions.claim: Urban plazas and West End miniparks must receive 0 m2 of new shadow 10:00-16:00 PDT on 22 Sept
falseAssumptions.correction: Parks, schools and the s.4.2 plazas (Jack Poole Plaza, Robson Square, Dilawri Square South): no new shadow within property lines, exceptions possible. Other urban plazas and miniparks: minimise where possible, report m2 and coverage %, no pass/fail.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vancouver tests downtown shadow impacts at both equinoxes (20/21 March and 22 Sept), 10:00-16:00
falseAssumptions.correction: Downtown Peninsula guidelines focus on the fall equinox (22 Sept, 10:00-16:00 PDT); the spring-equinox consideration was eliminated and a 4 Feb 2026 amendment also removed the spring study outside downtown. Further dates may be required (s.3.1.4, reviewer reading).

falseAssumptions.claim: Victory Square cenotaph circle is protected at 11:00 on Remembrance Day
falseAssumptions.correction: Rule 4.3.1: no shadow on the cenotaph circle 10:00-12:00 PST on 11 Nov, in addition to the s.3.1 rules; exceptions only with comprehensive public and stakeholder engagement (4.3.2).

falseAssumptions.claim: West-facing glazing gets about 17% more annual irradiation than east, independent of the horizon setting (P02-M05)
falseAssumptions.correction: Quote the horizon setting: 809 vs 688 kWh/m2/yr (17.6%) with the PVGIS DEM horizon, 809 vs 753 (7.4%) with none.

falseAssumptions.claim: A 30-year hourly WindClimate can carry one station record id, and series with different ids must never be merged.
falseAssumptions.correction: Allow a documented StationSplice of YVR climate IDs 1108447 and 1108395 with an overlap check, or use the single-id NOAA ISD record 718920-99999. Apply the no-merge rule between time bases, not inside a documented splice.

falseAssumptions.claim: A modelled context radius of about 350 m is adequate for this tower.
falseAssumptions.correction: Toronto states 350 m is a minimum and that tall buildings outside it that could influence the site must be included; Hamilton and City of London use 400 m. For H = 244-305 m, 350-400 m is about 1.1-1.6 H and the brief names approved towers of similar height. Use at least max(400 m, about 2H) plus influential towers beyond.

falseAssumptions.claim: A probe in an empty domain should reproduce the undisturbed profile speed at 1.5 m within 5% when the ABL uses Eddy3D defaults (Zref 10 m, z0 1 m).
falseAssumptions.correction: Test horizontal homogeneity of U, k and epsilon at 1.5 m, 10 m, H/2 and H at the building position. Use an atmospheric rough wall function with the inlet z0 on the approach fetch and a small z0 on the explicitly modelled ground; take the reference speed above 100 m.

falseAssumptions.claim: About 57 core-hours per million cells per direction, scaled linearly, is a lower bound for L2-lite cost.
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat it as an order of magnitude from one laboratory case, label it so on every map, and time one direction of the L2-lite template on the target hardware before offering L2-lite to entrants.

falseAssumptions.claim: Airport (YVR) or typical-year EPW wind equals the wind at the downtown site.
falseAssumptions.correction: Toronto requires 30 years of hourly airport data corrected for terrain and scaled via gradient height to the site; a typical-meteorological-year file is not a 30-year record and under-represents storms.

falseAssumptions.claim: Butterfly is a viable Python API for an OpenFOAM (Foundation v12) pipeline.
falseAssumptions.correction: Butterfly is unmaintained: latest commits 11 Sep 2020; the only OpenFOAM compatibility commit seen targets ESI OF1706+. Build case templates directly for the pinned Foundation version or use Eddy3D-generated cases.

falseAssumptions.claim: CFD acceptance bands FAC2 >= 0.5, |FB| <= 0.3, NMSE <= 4 (Chang and Hanna 2004) are suitable placeholders for pedestrian wind-speed validation.
falseAssumptions.correction: Use decision-level validation: comfort-class agreement and exceedance-probability bias against tunnel data on AIJ benchmark cases, plus the VDI 3783-9 hit rate once opened. Keep FAC2, FB and NMSE descriptive only and adopt no NMSE band.

falseAssumptions.claim: Calmer is always better: a Sitting-class wind condition is automatically good for outdoor use.
falseAssumptions.correction: Toronto notes wind speeds under 5 km/h most of the time can cause low air circulation, exhaust build-up and heat in full sun.

falseAssumptions.claim: City Lawson comfort is assessed 'for 95% of comfort hours' (the 06:00-23:00 convention).
falseAssumptions.correction: Run the City Lawson CriteriaSet on 24 h data for comfort and safety, using the Vancouver climate, with only the thresholds transferred, not the London climate coefficients.

falseAssumptions.claim: ECCC 1-, 2- or 10-minute mean speeds read higher than hourly means, so unconverted data inflate exceedances; a conversion factor should be applied to reach hourly means.
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat sampled ECCC means as hourly-mean estimates with no multiplicative conversion. Log the sampling period as metadata, and derive pedestrian gusts from VAF and turbulence only.

falseAssumptions.claim: ECCC hourly data code calm as direction 0, so 'direction 0 with speed 0' identifies calm hours (M01 'Calm hours handled' was marked verified).
falseAssumptions.correction: Calm = speed 0 whatever the direction field holds (ECCC hourly CSV: empty; NOAA ISD: type C with direction 999; TMYx: arbitrary direction). Keep calms in the denominator. An empty or 999 direction with speed above 0 is a variable-direction class.

falseAssumptions.claim: Early CFD can certify gust-safety compliance of a supertall scheme.
falseAssumptions.correction: Toronto states CFD struggles with separation, eddies and gusts and is not suited to safety-based issues; wind-tunnel testing is required for high triggers. Steady RANS also showed bias against tunnels.

falseAssumptions.claim: Lawson thresholds and RWDI/Toronto thresholds are interchangeable.
falseAssumptions.correction: They differ in exceedance basis and speed limits: Lawson-type sets use m/s at 5% of time (City Lawson 2.5/4/6/8 m/s on mean and GEM); RWDI/Toronto/Hamilton use GEM in km/h or mph at 20%. Using one speed table with the other exceedance gives wrong classes.

falseAssumptions.claim: RWDI and Toronto share one GEM criteria set of 10/15/20 km/h at 80%.
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat Toronto 2022 (three classes 10/15/20 km/h), Hamilton 2026 (four classes 10/14/17/20 km/h) and RWDI (four classes 6/8/10/12 mph, about 9.7/12.9/16.1/19.3 km/h) as separate CriteriaSets, each with its own safety criterion.

falseAssumptions.claim: RWDI considers sidewalks to need strolling or better.
falseAssumptions.correction: RWDI says conditions comfortable for walking or strolling are appropriate for sidewalks. Sidewalk requirement: Walking, with Strolling as a preference where the set has that class.

falseAssumptions.claim: Steady RANS in Hagbo and Giljarhus achieved Pearson r of 0.71-0.84, so 0.71 is the lower end and r can serve as pass/fail.
falseAssumptions.correction: Table 5 lists r down to 0.61 (247.5 degrees) up to 0.84 (180 degrees); the 0.71-0.84 range comes from the text only. r is scale-invariant and cannot detect the -1% to -35% mean-speed bias the same paper reports, so it is supplementary only.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Lawson criteria in Hagbo and Giljarhus are a verified mean/GEM criteria set.
falseAssumptions.correction: The paper uses 'a version of' Lawson, mean speed only, with no distress or safety criterion. The verified primary Lawson-type set in this packet is the City of London 2019 City Lawson (mean and GEM, 2.5/4/6/8 m/s at 5%, safety 15 m/s at 0.022%).

falseAssumptions.claim: Toronto and Hamilton both require at least 16 CFD wind directions.
falseAssumptions.correction: The 16-direction CFD minimum is Toronto 6.4.2. Hamilton's qualitative CFD may simulate only the prevailing directions (assessment still weights all directions) and Hamilton requires 36 directions only for tunnel tests; City of London asks for 36 in all studies.

falseAssumptions.claim: Toronto and Hamilton give no cyclist rule.
falseAssumptions.correction: Hamilton names cyclist areas and bicycle lanes as test locations under its standard pedestrian criteria; Toronto's guide has no cyclist text; only City of London adds a cyclist-specific safety note (15 m/s, a probe at least every 40 m).

falseAssumptions.claim: Toronto's low-wind note concerns GEM under 5 km/h.
falseAssumptions.correction: The note concerns wind speed (mean) under 5 km/h for the majority of the time (e.g. 80%); M04 bases the flag on mean speed and quotes 80% as an example.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vancouver Harbour CS provides an hourly wind record usable as a downtown cross-check (hourly year options 1976-2026).
falseAssumptions.correction: No downtown ECCC wind cross-check exists for the last 38 years. Use Harbour CS for temperature, humidity and hourly precipitation only; its 1976-1988 wind record is historical. Refuse the Harbour CS TMYx as a wind file.

falseAssumptions.claim: A massing-stage design passing the baseline path (<= 2 x baseline) is a meaningful compliance signal
falseAssumptions.correction: NRC s5.2 requires equivalent geometry and program, so a preset-built design equals its own baseline (ratio about 1.0). At f = 2 the baseline path is non-binding; the intensity path and expected-at-BP lines carry the test.

falseAssumptions.claim: Active cooling is required in every room of every dwelling (26 deg C, windows closed) from 1 Jan 2025
falseAssumptions.correction: BCBC 2024, adopted in VBBL 2025, requires at least one cool space at or below 26 deg C per dwelling at summer design temperature.

falseAssumptions.claim: Assembly, care and industrial (Group A, B, F) GHGI must be 85% below a fossil-fuel-only reference from Jan 2025 (City 2022 deck; round-1 critique)
falseAssumptions.correction: The adopted VBBL Table A (Mar 2025, Sep 2025, official consolidation) says 50% lower; EMG s5.3 example also uses 0.50.

falseAssumptions.claim: BC electricity at 0.011 kgCO2e/kWh means operational carbon is small, so embodied carbon dominates whole-life carbon (M08)
falseAssumptions.correction: 0.011 is the EMG compliance factor. BC's consumption-based Integrated Grid factor was 9.9 t/GWh (2024) and 22.8 t/GWh (2025), about twice 0.011; embodied carbon likely still dominates, but by less.

falseAssumptions.claim: Biogenic carbon is excluded from compliance, so timber storage cannot offset the compliance total
falseAssumptions.correction: Short-cycle biogenic carbon (growth cycle 10 years or less, waste, salvage, residues) may be deducted for compliance; other biogenic carbon, carbonation and Module D are reported separately.

falseAssumptions.claim: By-law 13472 limits (office 25, retail 14 kgCO2e/m2.yr) govern a new tower's permit
falseAssumptions.correction: They apply to existing office and retail buildings over 100,000 ft2 from 2026; new towers are governed by VBBL Part 10 and the rezoning policy.

falseAssumptions.claim: Current energy rule for cultural/civic ('all other') space is the 2018-20 rule (TEUI 35% better than baseline, TEDI and GHGI equal to baseline)
falseAssumptions.correction: Table A (from Jul 2023, unchanged in Mar and Sep 2025): GHGI limit is 50% below a fossil-fuel-only reference model; TEUI/TEDI follow the NECB 2020 / ASHRAE 90.1-2019 reference model (EMG s5.1-5.3).

falseAssumptions.claim: District steam connection qualifies as an LCES and earns Table C relief
falseAssumptions.correction: Only conditionally: the 2021 City letter recognises planned electrode boilers if built as planned, not for permits before approvals and construction start, and with written utility confirmation. Under the LCES Policy it is a Type 4 route with extra conditions.

falseAssumptions.claim: EMG v3.0 cuts the corridor TEDI/TEUI adjustment maximum from 10 to 5 and removes the GHGI adjustment (the r1 correction)
falseAssumptions.correction: Final EMG v3.0 s2.5.2 keeps the TEDI adjustment maximum at 10 (minimum 0), sets the TEUI adjustment equal to it, and shows no GHGI adjustment. Focal's 5 was a recommendation that the final text did not adopt.

falseAssumptions.claim: Embodied carbon above 800 kgCO2e/m2 fails in any case
falseAssumptions.correction: 800 (2 x 400 x GFA) is the intensity-path limit only. The baseline path allows up to 2 x a functionally equivalent baseline, which can exceed 800 for a supertall.

falseAssumptions.claim: GHGI-R (refrigerant leakage) counts inside the GHGI limit from January 2025
falseAssumptions.correction: EMG v3.0 defines GHGI-R as a separate metric with no compliance requirement; Table A GHGI covers energy only.

falseAssumptions.claim: High-rise residential GHGI limit is 6 kgCO2e/m2.yr and hotel GHGI is 8 (2020-2023 tables, 2020 case study, ZEBX primer)
falseAssumptions.correction: For permits from January 2025 the City's approved changes set 7+ storey residential GHGI at 3 and hotel at 4 (GHGI-R now included).

falseAssumptions.claim: In a mixed-use building only the residential portion must separately meet its own TEDI limit
falseAssumptions.correction: All portions with a table TEDI target must meet their combined TEDI target, and portions with an absolute GHGI target their combined GHGI target, in addition to whole-building limits (EMG s5.1(e)).

falseAssumptions.claim: Pool and amenity space raises TEDI sharply (58% of heating from pools)
falseAssumptions.correction: Under EMG v3.0 definitions pool-water heating, DHW and humidification are excluded from TEDI; they count in TEUI and GHGI. Pool-hall conditioning and ventilation heating still count in TEDI.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 2021-table TEUI/TEDI values and the Jan 2025 GHGI step were 'verified' from a consultant page and a 2022 deck
falseAssumptions.correction: Values are now verified in the City's wordings: GHGI steps took effect in the 1 Mar 2025 wording (not January 2025); TEUI/TEDI cells unchanged since Jan 2022.

falseAssumptions.claim: The 2025 embodied-carbon limits (360/320 absolute; 10% or 20% reduction plus responsible-materials option) are in force and 'verified'
falseAssumptions.correction: VBBL 10.4.1.2 (15 Sep 2025) and Addendum v1.0 set f = 2 (limit = 2 x benchmark). The 2025 reductions were proposed, then listed by the City as delayed; next update TBD.

falseAssumptions.claim: The City halved the TEDI/TEUI corridor-pressurization credit (complete description of the change)
falseAssumptions.correction: Superseded in r2: the final EMG v3.0 keeps the corridor TEDI adjustment maximum at 10 (minimum 0), TEUI adjustment equal to TEDI adjustment, and shows no GHGI adjustment. Focal's 5 was a recommendation.

falseAssumptions.claim: The City's 2030 embodied-carbon aspiration is 240 kgCO2e/m2 (0.6 x 400)
falseAssumptions.correction: The City proposal (S52) lists 2030 as baseline path -40% with the absolute path TBD; 240 is team arithmetic and appears only as a labelled dashed line.

falseAssumptions.claim: The ICE database can be used freely for project embodied-carbon calculations in the tool
falseAssumptions.correction: ICE Educational V5.0 is educational-only; non-educational use is not permitted after 30 Sep 2026 and it cannot be used in tools or reporting.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Sustainable Large Developments policy requires a low-carbon energy supply feasibility study that M06 should feed as a rezoning deliverable
falseAssumptions.correction: SLD (amended 31 Mar 2026; sites of 8,000 m2 or more, or 45,000 m2 of new floor area) has sections A-G: site design, food assets, green mobility, potable water, groundwater, zero waste, affordable housing. It has no energy section or energy study.

falseAssumptions.claim: Tower dwellings can rely on passive cooling if overheating stays under 200 hours
falseAssumptions.correction: From 1 Jan 2025 all dwelling units in new Part 3 buildings must have active cooling able to hold 26 C with windows closed.

falseAssumptions.claim: VBBL Table A (or Table C with an LCES) sets the energy targets for a VTC tower, and the Higher Buildings Policy's sustainability expectations are unknown
falseAssumptions.correction: HBP s2.2 (amended 31 Mar 2026) requires Passive House, or TEUI/TEDI/GHGI targets (residential 100/15/3, hotel 120/15/4, retail and office 100/15/1.5) AND LCES connection with no aggregation; the GBPR also applies.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vancouver requires new towers to cut embodied carbon by 40%
falseAssumptions.correction: The 40% is a city-wide 2030 target in the Climate Emergency Action Plan. The by-law requires reporting within 2x baseline from Oct 2023 and 10% (20% for low-rise wood) reductions plus a responsible-materials option from the 2025 code.

falseAssumptions.claim: Whether an all-electric heat-pump plant counts as an on-site LCES is unresolved
falseAssumptions.correction: LCES Policy Type 3 sets criteria: seasonal average COP > 2, modelled GHGI < limit minus 33%, gas peaking sized to augment, 2-year and 5-year contracts, and an engineer's written verification.

falseAssumptions.claim: Whether on-site PV lowers GHGI under EMG v3.0 is unresolved
falseAssumptions.correction: Final EMG Eq. 2 subtracts site renewable generation before applying the emission factor, so PV lowers GHGI at 0.011 kgCO2e/kWh as well as TEUI.

falseAssumptions.claim: 'At least 3 mature trees visible from each dwelling or workplace' is a verified threshold (P05-M08).
falseAssumptions.correction: The paper says the number 3 is not supported by scientific evidence, sets no viewing distance and ignores upper floors. M08 treats it as a research_heuristic with the paper's Dutch example (crowns of at least 25 m2 within a 30 m buffer), reported per floor band.

falseAssumptions.claim: 'City in Nature' has no official definition: the phrase is not in official text and the nearest framing is ODP Big Idea 3 plus Part 5 s.4 Ecology.
falseAssumptions.correction: The City's Higher Buildings Policy Review exhibit has a section 'A City in Nature' citing ODP policy L2.3.1: buildings and sites provide space for nature, and views and connections to mountains, water and landscapes are protected. M01 has two halves: space for nature (M02-M07) and views (SITE, M08).

falseAssumptions.claim: 50 m2 of canopy per tree is the City's own planning figure.
falseAssumptions.correction: It is a footnote assumption for UFS Figure 13 (assumes 50 m2 of canopy per tree), not a standard. Calculations use species crowns; 50 m2 only sizes the illustrative tree count.

falseAssumptions.claim: A 'verified' status means a threshold binds the project.
falseAssumptions.correction: Status records only whether the source says it (verified = read at source; unverified = not opened or partly read; team_assumption = no source gives the value). A required force field records bindingness; M01 pass/fail counts only bylaw_requirement and rezoning_policy_requirement.

falseAssumptions.claim: Entering the Queen Elizabeth Park view cone is a protected-view intrusion that counts against City in Nature half (b) unless justified (M01, M08).
falseAssumptions.correction: The Higher Buildings Policy is the pathway for buildings entering the QE Park view, and Public Views Guidelines 3.4 lets Exceptional Downtown Sites (parcel 8,000 m2 or more) encroach into view 3 and B1, B2, D, 12.2. Score only non-listed cones; report QE entry as a pathway card with a skyline-contribution judgment.

falseAssumptions.claim: R019 outdoor potable-water baseline = 120 mm x landscaped area, with no period stated (M04).
falseAssumptions.correction: R019 4.1.1.2: baseline is monthly, in L/month, for July (ETo 120 mm): 120 mm x total proposed landscaped area (planted landscapes on structures included), with the LEED v4 calculator and Table 2 climate normals; RPSLD D.3.3 also requires the Water Wise Landscape Guidelines.

falseAssumptions.claim: R019 quotes 22% only as the outdated city-wide canopy goal.
falseAssumptions.correction: R019 1.2.1 also says larger sites (Type A and B) should target a minimum 22% canopy, which conflicts with its own Type B band of 15-20%. M02 shows both for Type A/B and flags the inconsistency; Type C (10-15%) is unaffected.

falseAssumptions.claim: R019 requires permanent cast-in-place roof planters and no containers (M03 life-safety gate).
falseAssumptions.correction: R019 1.1 says roof tree planters should be permanent, substantial and cast in place wherever possible, and to avoid container planting: a design consideration. The gate is advisory; registered-professional anchorage design remains the binding judgment.

falseAssumptions.claim: Rainwater requirements for the tower come through rezoning policy and the Rain City 48 mm/day standard binds private sites.
falseAssumptions.correction: Rainwater rules were simplified in the rezoning policies in July 2023 and removed from the Zoning and Development By-law on 1 Jan 2024. The Vancouver Building By-law 2025, Book II Art. 2.4.2.5 now governs: engineered pathway for sites over 1,000 m2, detention with 10-year 2100 IDF, release 5 then 25 L/s/ha. The City says Rain City 48 mm targets are superseded on private property; they remain an aspiration. Site-specific rezoning conditions may still apply.

falseAssumptions.claim: Solar Access Guidelines say development should cast zero new shadow on all listed parks and plazas on the fall equinox 10:00-16:00 PT (M06, force rezoning_target).
falseAssumptions.correction: Only Community, Neighbourhood and Local parks and school sites get the should-not rule (3.1.1). Plazas and West End miniparks: minimise where possible (3.2.1). Special cases: 4.1-4.3 and village sidewalks (3.3). Guidelines are discretionary, so force is voluntary_guideline.

falseAssumptions.claim: Standard 621 flashing-only Configuration A' is a possible bird-friendly obstruction-lighting option for the VTC building, pending Transport Canada acceptance (M05).
falseAssumptions.correction: s.5.4 information note limits A' to towers and similar skeletal structures. Buildings fall under s.5.6 (steady CL-810; flashing CL-864 only where early or special pilot warning is needed), Chapter 6 (white CL-865) or Chapter 7 (high-intensity white, not for 150 m or less).

falseAssumptions.claim: The 1997 Higher Buildings Policy linked in the VTC brief is the governing text and sets ecology or City in Nature criteria.
falseAssumptions.correction: The same URL now returns the policy amended through 31 March 2026. It sets design excellence, community benefit and energy/GHG (or Passive House) requirements and has no ecology, bird or rainwater clause; the Green Buildings Policy for Rezonings applies.

falseAssumptions.claim: The InVEST cooling shade term can include the tower's own shadow, so shading by the tower raises cooling capacity.
falseAssumptions.correction: InVEST defines shade as tree canopy 2 m or taller; building shade is not in the index. M06 credits only vegetation and designed shade, reports building shade separately, and pairs CC with the fall-equinox new-shadow check.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Vancouver Bird Strategy is a 2015 document.
falseAssumptions.correction: The cover reads 'January 2015 (Updated December 2020)'; cite it as 2020 (update). The 2017 study it cites appears only in the update.

falseAssumptions.claim: The bird-collision zone top is 12 m (4th floor, Explanatory Note).
falseAssumptions.correction: Vancouver's clause says up to the fourth floor or mature tree height, whichever is highest. A supertall podium with tall retail, lobby and transit storeys can put the 4th storey top well above 12 m, so the zone is computed from Layer 0 storey levels; 12 m and 16 m are comparators.

falseAssumptions.claim: The city-wide canopy target is 22% by 2050.
falseAssumptions.correction: 30% by 2050 (Park Board 7 Dec 2020; Urban Forest Strategy 2025; ODP policy 4.2.3).

falseAssumptions.claim: Toronto EC 1.1 supports size-class soil presets below 30 m3 for small and medium trees at 0.6 m3 per m2 of crown (M02).
falseAssumptions.correction: EC 1.1 gives 30 m3 per separate planting area regardless of tree size, plus a site total of 40% x site area / 66 m2 x 30 m3 (about 2,085 m3 for 11,468 m2). Use 30 m3 per tree as floor; any size scaling is a team assumption.

falseAssumptions.claim: Toronto Green Standard v4 EC 2.1, EC 2.2 and EC 2.3 are current Toronto Tier 1 requirements, and EC 2.1 is 50% for a mixed-use tower.
falseAssumptions.correction: Toronto marks EC 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3 voluntary for applications on or after 2 June 2026 (page modified 24 Aug 2026). EC 2.1 is 75% for residential uses and 50% for non-residential; M06 chooses the line per frontage.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vancouver Bird Friendly Design Guidelines require marker gaps <= 5 cm vertical AND <= 10 cm horizontal (P05-M05 metric, status verified).
falseAssumptions.correction: Clause 3.3(a)(ii) says no greater than 5 cm vertically or 10 cm horizontally, markers on the exterior surface; use is 'encouraged', not required. M05 passes a pattern meeting either limit (dots meet both); unit test: a 5 cm horizontal-stripe frit passes.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vancouver advises planting 0-1 m from glass (M05).
falseAssumptions.correction: Bird Friendly 3.3(c)(i) asks first for landscaping at an appropriate distance from glass to reduce reflections; 0-1 m adjacent, or making glass visible, is the fallback.

falseAssumptions.claim: A building's shadow polygon is the convex hull of its footprint and the footprint shifted by H / tan(elevation) (P06-M03 method).
falseAssumptions.correction: Project each constant-footprint slab at its own height (footprint swept from base to top along the shadow direction: both end polygons plus swept edge parallelograms), union all slabs and context, then intersect with protected spaces; validate against ray casts on a stepped massing.

falseAssumptions.claim: CDDG G4.4.1 (station overbuild and plaza checklist) applies only where a development includes a station overbuild or primary headhouse; the VTC brief may not include one (P06-M04).
falseAssumptions.correction: G4.4.2a says integrated station entrances must meet the form and massing guidelines for overbuild and plaza fit-out in 4.4.1, so the VTC's required secondary entrance triggers the G4.4.1 a-h checklist (overbuild-dependent items 'where feasible').

falseAssumptions.claim: CDDG S2.2.8 allows 21.3 m podiums only for residential or other listed exceptions.
