falseAssumptions.claim: TCPS 2 Article 2.5 exempts the planned designer studies as 'testing within normal educational requirements' used only for assessment or improvement.
falseAssumptions.correction: Cite the quality-improvement wording of Article 2.5, commit to no research reuse of the data without REB review, let the instructor and UBC research ethics decide, and do not recruit entrants to work on live entries.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Codex CLI licence is unverified.
falseAssumptions.correction: Record Apache-2.0 and pin the version; install on Windows with npm at a pinned version rather than the piped installer.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Higher Buildings Policy PDF cannot be obtained (only via guidelines.vancouver.ca, HTTP 403).
falseAssumptions.correction: The City project page links a second copy. A team member downloads it in a browser, records SHA-256, edition and date, and a second person reviews the height, policy-area and criteria clauses; the attempt is logged if it fails.

falseAssumptions.claim: The Okabe-Ito page gives vermilion as #FF2000 (a reliable hex anchor), and its palette hexes can be used without a contrast check.
falseAssumptions.correction: Treat all palette hexes, vermilion included, as team presets checked for contrast in both themes.

falseAssumptions.claim: The W3C Web Annotation model establishes that TextQuoteSelector survives re-pagination.
falseAssumptions.correction: Present 'survives re-pagination' as team reasoning; cite W3C only for exact/prefix/suffix and for TextPositionSelector being very brittle.

falseAssumptions.claim: The jury weights 40/30/20/10 are 'verified'.
falseAssumptions.correction: The weights are a team assumption until a person opens the brief PDF and reviews the brief card; the brief is source P16-S58 (opened=false).

falseAssumptions.claim: The provider retention to plan for is Anthropic 30-day deletion and OpenAI 30-day abuse-monitoring logs.
falseAssumptions.correction: Set store:false on every OpenAI Responses call; never send feedback ratings; batch, files and vector stores only for public or planted data with a scheduled deletion job; keep a per-feature retention table.

falseAssumptions.claim: The sharp library used for metadata stripping is at https://github.com/lcovarrubias/sharp-placeholder-not-used.
falseAssumptions.correction: Cite https://github.com/lovell/sharp and the output docs (all metadata, including ICC, is removed by default unless keepMetadata or withMetadata is used); a person reads the pages and records the licence; a CI link check (lychee) fails on any dead library or source URL.

falseAssumptions.claim: (r1 critique) Infrared.city's 'Students & small studies' label belongs to the Starter tier, not the Free tier
falseAssumptions.correction: Free tier: students and small studies, 900 one-time tokens, 42-day expiry. S31 extract kept; the UNRESOLVED flag is closed.

falseAssumptions.claim: (r3 critique) Demo C5 used 329 evaluations against a 300 budget in the complete project
falseAssumptions.correction: Case study C reports the two results separately; no single 329-versus-300 comparison is made.

falseAssumptions.claim: (r3 critique) The Academic Sponsorship Plan is the only route to SimScale urban wind (pedestrian wind comfort and LBM)
falseAssumptions.correction: No free SimScale route to LBM or PWC exists on any plan page opened (S58, S68, S76); they need a paid Professional or Enterprise add-on (price not listed). Sponsorship gives other CFD types with private projects, by application. Access for tower wind is set to 'no free route', not 'unknown pending sponsorship'.

falseAssumptions.claim: (r3 critique) The course notes state the demo D round counts (4 of 12 failed, 12 of 12 passed) as across three runs, so 'inferred' can be dropped
falseAssumptions.correction: Counts kept as 'read as totals across 3 runs (not stated outright)'; D3 marked n=1 (accepted).

falseAssumptions.claim: Archistar is a site-feasibility or massing-generation tool comparable to TestFit or Giraffe
falseAssumptions.correction: The Archistar products page describes AI PreCheck (formerly eCheck), a permit-stage plan-review tool for governments and certifiers. (r1 update: the Industry & Certifiers page also advertises a generative design library and a Forma integration; see the later flag on Archistar's product line.)

falseAssumptions.claim: Archistar's current product line is plan review only; no design generation is described (round-0 case study and S27 extract)
falseAssumptions.correction: Describe Archistar as AI plan review (AI PreCheck) plus an advertised generative-design library and Forma integration whose capability is unverified.

falseAssumptions.claim: Autodesk Forma access for a VTC student team is UNKNOWN, and its analyses (sun, wind, noise, carbon) can only be stated as uncitable general knowledge
falseAssumptions.correction: Forma is free for students and educators (vendor statement); a logged-in team member confirms eligibility. Sun, noise, wind and embodied carbon are vendor-stated; daylight, microclimate and supertall validity stay UNVERIFIED. Forma Site Design name and 30-day trial are seen only in search results.

falseAssumptions.claim: Board count, size and the 10 MB limit used in the step 8 and 9 pre-flight checks come from the competition page (S01)
falseAssumptions.correction: Steps 0, 8 and 9 now cite S01 only for English, anonymity, dates, fees and prizes, and cite 4 x A2, 10 MB, 9.0 FSR, 244-305 m and jury weights to S78 as 'project description, unverified'.

falseAssumptions.claim: Giraffe has no education pricing, and its free-plan and education terms are unconfirmed
falseAssumptions.correction: Giraffe is free for students and universities (vendor statement). Vancouver data coverage remains UNVERIFIED.

falseAssumptions.claim: In the B_testfit demo, hand estimates were wrong (255 vs 223 homes measured) and the guard was bypassed by a counter import
falseAssumptions.correction: Attribute 255 vs 223 to D, the import bypass to C, and keep the B evidence to B. The case study is split into B, C and D.

falseAssumptions.claim: Ladybug licence: 'copyleft either way', so the difference between AGPL and GPL does not matter
falseAssumptions.correction: Record the core libraries as AGPL-3.0. Decision for the DATA packet (not legal advice): either run ladybug/honeybee client-side or in a separately licensed service, or license the platform (or that service) so its source can be offered to users. Hosting any modified Ladybug code means publishing it.

falseAssumptions.claim: SimScale Community or the Free Academic Plan is a usable CFD route for the wind study ('a real CFD route if a surrogate is not trusted'; 'usable before 30 Nov: yes for basic CFD on Community')
falseAssumptions.correction: SimScale case study and step 4 rewritten: no urban-wind route on Community or Free Academic; at most limited steady incompressible CFD with CFD skill. The 'real CFD route' wording is withdrawn.

falseAssumptions.claim: SimScale has no academic or student plan (S58 case study)
falseAssumptions.correction: Routes: Community (free; private projects not included, so projects are implied public) or Academic Sponsorship Plan by application (terms and turnaround unknown). Public projects may expose the scheme before anonymous judging.

falseAssumptions.claim: Snaptrude has no student or education offer; a 4-person team needs four free single-user accounts or a paid plan
falseAssumptions.correction: Free for enrolled architecture, design and engineering students and educators: full features, unlimited projects, real-time collaboration, 120 AI credits a year (S66), 1-year renewable licence verified by school email, educational use only. Whether that covers a prize competition is UNVERIFIED.

falseAssumptions.claim: Speckle's free plan caps at 3 users, so a 4-person VTC team would exceed it and must pay
falseAssumptions.correction: For a UBC team, apply to academia@speckle.systems; Explore limits are 1 project, 3 users including external collaborators, 100 versions and 30-day history. Treat the academic terms as UNVERIFIED until UBC applies. The earlier note that a 4-person team must pay is withdrawn.

falseAssumptions.claim: TestFit does not show tall mixed-use buildings (it is only parking, multi-family and similar)
falseAssumptions.correction: Mixed-use is claimed for Site Solver only (from USD 15,000/yr). Office and tower capability are unverified. A university route exists with unknown terms.

falseAssumptions.claim: The cove.tool SaaS is not described anywhere on the cove.inc pages, and its availability cannot be confirmed (round-0 case study and UNRESOLVED flag)
falseAssumptions.correction: The platform survives as analysis.tool for existing paying clients only; there is no student or academic access, so VTC student teams cannot use it. Treat as a design pattern only.

falseAssumptions.claim: Vancouver's View Protection Guidelines (with the Higher Buildings Policy) govern the protected-view envelope for the VTC tower (steps 0, 1b, 7b and the UNVERIFIED flag)
falseAssumptions.correction: Steps 0, 1b, 7b and flags now name the Public Views Guidelines (2024, replaced the 1989 VPG). Height rules stay UNVERIFIED until a person opens the PDF.
